name: Philippines — 6 January 2026 (RR 29-2025)

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
officialgazette.gov.ph — the Official Gazette: Republic Acts, proclamations, executive orders. A proclamation is /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/proclamation-no-<n>-s-<year>/ (HTML, full text); /section/proclamations/ lists the newest first; /nationwide-holidays/<year>/ is the holiday calendar. lawphil.net mirrors the same texts and is corroboration only.
sss.gov.ph — /pay-contribution/ carries the contribution schedule (the 2025 table PDF under /wp-content/uploads/ is 6.3 MB, over the reader limit: read the HTML page); /sss-circulars/ lists circulars by year.
philhealth.gov.ph — /advisories/<year>/ lists advisories; each is /advisories/<year>/PA<year>-<nnnn>.pdf (small, text). the premium schedule is PhilHealth Circular 2020-0005 (Revision 1), /circulars/2020/circ2020-0005.pdf (5 scanned pages, no text layer: §V.A the table, §V.B the equal employee/employer split), which each CY advisory cites; /partners/employers/ContributionTable_v2.pdf is the superseded 2019-0009 infographic and is not an authority.
pagibigfund.gov.ph serves a reCAPTCHA page, not the PDF: cite Circular 460 (15 January 2024, from February 2024; the 1%/2% tiers and the ₱10,000 fund salary cap) from its copy annexed to DMW Advisory 37-2025 (https://wcms.dmw.gov.ph/uploads/DMW_ADVISORY_37_2025_01225b9fec.pdf, 6 scanned pages, Circular 460 on pp.2–6), and Circular 275 from the Wayback copy (https://web.archive.org/web/2020id_/https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/document/pdf/circulars/provident/HDMF%20Circular%20275%20-%20Implementing%20Guidelines%20on%20Employer%20Registration%20Contribution%20and%20Remittance.pdf).
bir.gov.ph — bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex E RR 11-2018.pdf is the withholding table (monthly and semi-monthly columns, 0.3 MB); revenue regulation digests are under bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/.
nwpc.dole.gov.ph — regional wage orders: /ncr/, /region-iva/ (and the other regions); /bwc-handbook-workers-statutory-monetary-benefits/ is the DOLE Handbook (factors, premiums, 13th month).
pco.gov.ph answers 403 to the reader; use the Gazette.

Finding changes (read these before comparing, every run):
Wage orders: read https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/feed/ (RSS) for new RTWPB orders, then open https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/statistics/summary-of-latest-wage-orders-issued-by-the-regional-boards/ and follow its 'Download PDF' (Latest-Wage-Order-Matrix-<date>.pdf, a text PDF with issue/publication/effectivity per region). Effectivity is 15 days after publication when the matrix leaves it blank. The regional pages (/ncr/, /region-iva/ …) link the signed wage-order PDFs. These are scans with no text layer, so take the figures from the matrix. SSS: newest CI number on /sss-circulars/, and the rate table on /pay-contribution/. PhilHealth: /advisories/<YYYY>/ and /circulars/<YYYY>/; premium changes are 'Premium Contribution … for CY<YYYY>' advisories. BIR: every www.bir.gov.ph listing (RR, RMC, WithHoldingTax) is a client-rendered shell ('Loading…'), so it cannot be read. Discover RR/RMC numbers from a big-4 alert list (PwC PH Tax Alerts, SGV/EY Tax Bulletin), then open the PDF at https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RR%20No.%20<n>-<yyyy>.pdf. Holidays: lawphil proclamation index for discovery only (officialgazette.gov.ph returns 403). Pag-IBIG and DOLE/BWC labor advisories are bot-walled: use news only to discover, and do not cite them.
Watch Wage Order No. NCR-27 (approved 23 June 2026: +₱60, then a second ₱25 tranche on 20 January 2027). NCR-28's recital says it never took effect under a status quo ante order, a TRO and a writ of preliminary injunction, and nwpc.dole.gov.ph/ncr/ marks it "subject to continuing litigation pending before RTC Pasig Branch 152 and RTC Navotas Branch 287". Read that page's NCR-27 notice on every check: if the courts lift the injunction, the 20 January 2027 tranche (and any restored NCR-27 rates) needs a new version from its effective date; NCR-28 (effective 26 September 2026) is not necessarily the last NCR order for that period.

change_summary: RR 29-2025 (dated 27 October 2025, posted on the BIR website 22 December 2025, in force fifteen days later, 6 January 2026; s.3) raises every de minimis ceiling of RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3): monetised leave 10 → 12 days, dependants’ medical ₱1,500 → ₱2,000 a semester, rice ₱2,000 → ₱2,500 and laundry ₱300 → ₱400 a month, uniform ₱7,000 → ₱8,000, medical assistance, achievement awards and CBA/productivity ₱10,000 → ₱12,000, Christmas gifts ₱5,000 → ₱6,000, the overtime/night meal 25% → 30% of the regional minimum wage. Later regional wage orders are dated entries of the PAYROLL rule `minimum_wage`, not versions.

employment_type.description: Labor Code arts.295–296 (regular, project, seasonal, casual, probationary), fixed-term employment, arts.58–72 apprentices, RA 12063 trainees and RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) DOMESTIC: a kasambahay takes ANNUAL_LEAVE_DOMESTIC, no company loan, the domestic wage floor and the household contribution rules. CAREGIVER: RA 11965 (Caregivers’ Welfare Act) — the regional minimum wage, twice-monthly pay, 13th month, five-day SIL, overtime and night-shift pay, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG from the first day.

work_classification.description: Labor Code arts.82, 219(m): managerial employees are outside SIL, 13th month, premium, overtime and night pay; SUPERVISORY and MANAGERIAL fringe benefits bear the FBT (NIRC s.33), rank-and-file’s are compensation.

statutory_work_category.description: Labor Code art.82 field personnel and task-basis workers are outside service incentive leave; task-basis workers outside 13th-month pay, piece-rate workers inside it (PD 851 Revised Guidelines).

residency_status.description: NIRC ss.22(E)–(G), 24(A), 25(A)–(B): NON_RESIDENT_ALIEN_NETB (not engaged in trade or business) is withheld 25% final on gross compensation; the others on the graduated tables.

days_per_year.title: Days-per-year factor
days_per_year.description: The factor that turns the monthly basic into a daily rate (DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.2 §D–E): 365 when rest days, special days and regular holidays are paid; 313 on a six-day week; 261 on a five-day week; 305 / 253 where the special days are unpaid. Read by every day- and hour-rated line, retirement pay, the kasambahay pay, the WTAX leave ceiling and the minimum-wage-earner floor. Unrecorded is 313.

ebet_program.title: Registered EBET programme
ebet_program.description: Customer input. RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: the programme an INTERN or APPRENTICE contract is enrolled in — general training (an allowance, no wage floor, s.13(a)), apprenticeship (75% of the floor, s.13(b)), upskilling (the full wage, s.12).

rate_basis.title: Rate basis
rate_basis.description: Customer input. MONTHLY: `base_salary` is the monthly salary. DAILY: `base_salary` is the daily rate, paid for each day worked or on paid leave plus unworked regular holidays (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.2).

hours_per_day.title: Normal hours a day
hours_per_day.description: Customer input. A part-time contract’s normal hours; the hourly rate and the minimum-wage and MWE tests read the rate for an 8-hour day. Unrecorded is 8.

wage_region.title: Workplace wage-order key
wage_region.description: Customer input. The key of the PAYROLL rule `minimum_wage` for the employee’s place of work (RA 6727 s.4: the floor follows the workplace), when it differs from the entity’s `region`.

mine_worker.title: Mine worker
mine_worker.description: Customer input. RA 8558 / RA 10757: retirement from fifty, compulsory at sixty.

wage_payment_medium.title: Wage payment medium
wage_payment_medium.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.1: wages in legal tender; tokens, promissory notes, vouchers or coupons are absolutely prohibited. s.2: cheques or money orders only where customary, under a CBA, or on all four conditions (the entity fact `wage_payment_conditions_met`).

wage_payment_place.title: Wage payment place
wage_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4: at or near the place of undertaking; elsewhere only when peace and order or a calamity prevents it, the employer gives free transport both ways, or in analogous circumstances (the collecting time is hours worked); never in a bar, club, drinking, massage, dance or gaming place unless the employee works there.

employed_at_payment_place.title: Employee works at the bar, club or gaming place
employed_at_payment_place.description: Customer input. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.4(d): the exception for persons employed in those places.

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts when the contract closes (with the offboarding ground, last_day and note).

termination_cause.description: Labor Code arts.298–299 and DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.14 §C (customer input): the authorised cause. Labour-saving devices, redundancy and an impossible reinstatement pay a month a year; retrenchment, a closure not due to serious losses, disease, a security guard without assignment for six months (DO 150-16) and a contractor’s worker without assignment for three months (DO 174-17 s.13) half a month a year, at least a month; a closure due to serious losses pays none. A bona fide suspension of operations past six months (art.301; DO 215-20) is retrenchment pay, half a month a year.

terminated_for_disease.description: Labor Code art.299: separation pay of one month or half a month a year, whichever is greater.

kasambahay_unjust_dismissal.description: RA 10361 s.32: fifteen days’ pay as indemnity.

kasambahay_unjustified_departure.description: RA 10361 s.32: up to fifteen days’ unpaid salary forfeited.

reference_number.description: The member number for the scheme: SSS number, PhilHealth Identification Number, Pag-IBIG MID number or BIR TIN.

covered_before_60.title: SSS member covered before sixty
covered_before_60.description: SSS standing election (RA 11199 s.9(a)), an override: coverage past sixty is derived from the employment — hired before sixty, or an SSS charge on this payroll in the twelve months before; set this when the member was first covered before sixty through an earlier employer. Nothing is charged from sixty-five (s.12-B).

exempt_by_totalisation.title: Exempt from SSS under a social security agreement
exempt_by_totalisation.description: SSS standing election (customer input): a foreign employee covered by their own system under a Philippine bilateral social security agreement.

previous_employer_taxable_compensation.title: Previous employer’s taxable compensation this year
previous_employer_taxable_compensation.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s BIR Form 2316 (RR 2-98 s.2.79(B)(5)(b) Step 2): added to the year-end annualisation. Its presence also disqualifies substituted filing.

previous_employer_tax_withheld.title: Tax withheld by the previous employer this year
previous_employer_tax_withheld.description: Customer input from the previous employer’s 2316: credited in the annualisation.

coe_requested_on.title: Certificate of employment requested on
coe_requested_on.description: Customer input: the day a current employee asked for a certificate of employment (DOLE LA 06-20 Part III: within three days).

night_work_alternative_until.title: Alternative to night work until
night_work_alternative_until.description: Customer input: the last day of an additional period, during pregnancy or after the post-childbirth period, for which a medical certificate states that an alternative to night work is necessary for the health of the mother or child (Labor Code art.158(b) as inserted by RA 10151).

last_name.title: Last name
last_name.description: Customer input: the surname as the BIR records it (with its particles, e.g. DELA CRUZ). When set, the 1604-C alphalist reads the declared name parts instead of splitting `name`.

first_name.title: First name
first_name.description: Customer input: the given name(s) for the BIR alphalist (with last_name).

middle_name.title: Middle name
middle_name.description: Customer input: the middle name for the BIR alphalist (with last_name).

retirement_plan_exemption_availed.title: RA 4917 retirement exemption already availed
retirement_plan_exemption_availed.description: Customer input: the employee already received a tax-exempt retirement benefit under a private plan (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a): the exemption is availed of only once).

entity_input_schema.title: PH entity inputs
entity_input_schema.description: entity.facts (CEL company.facts.*). The entity `region` column names the wage-order floor key of the PAYROLL rule `minimum_wage` (by_region, or by_employment_type.DOMESTIC for a household employer).

small_establishment.title: Regularly fewer than ten employees
small_establishment.description: Labor Code art.95(b); Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(e): outside service incentive leave.

retirement_exempt_establishment.title: Retail, service or agricultural establishment of ten or fewer
retirement_exempt_establishment.description: Labor Code art.302 (RA 7641): outside retirement pay.

bmbe_certificate_of_authority.title: Certified BMBE
bmbe_certificate_of_authority.description: RA 9178 s.8: a Barangay Micro Business Enterprise with a current Certificate of Authority is exempt from the Minimum Wage Law, so its non-household employees are not minimum wage earners for WTAX.

philhealth_employer_number.title: PhilHealth Employer Number (PEN)
philhealth_employer_number.description: RA 11223 s.10; its last digit picks the remittance window (PhilHealth Circular 0001 s.2014).

bir_tin.title: BIR TIN of the withholding agent

hdmf_remittance_group.title: Pag-IBIG remittance group
hdmf_remittance_group.description: HDMF Circular 275 §E.2: the first letter of the employer’s registered name picks the window in the month after the period — 1 = A–D (10th–14th), 2 = E–L (15th–19th), 3 = M–Q (20th–24th), 4 = R–Z or a numeral (25th to month-end). Unrecorded, the earliest window governs.

nsd_small_retail_exempt.title: Retail or service establishment of five workers or fewer
nsd_small_retail_exempt.description: DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.5 §B.2 (Labor Code art.86; Omnibus Rules Book III Rule II s.1): outside the night-shift differential. Unrecorded, the differential is paid.

minimum_wage_exemption_approved.title: Exempted from the wage order by the regional board
minimum_wage_exemption_approved.description: RA 6727 s.4(c): an establishment the regional wages board exempted from the wage order in force. Unrecorded, no exemption.

retail_or_service_establishment.title: Retail or service establishment
retail_or_service_establishment.description: Customer input. With the entity’s headcount: holiday pay excludes one regularly employing fewer than ten (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.1(b)), the night-shift differential one of five or fewer.

maternity_differential_exempt.title: Exempt from the maternity salary differential
maternity_differential_exempt.description: Customer input. RA 11210 s.5(c) and IRR Rule VI: distressed, retail/service of ten or fewer, micro business, or already paying the equivalent.

collects_service_charges.title: Collects service charges
collects_service_charges.description: Customer input. Labor Code art.96 as amended by RA 11360: hotels, restaurants and similar establishments.

wage_payment_conditions_met.title: Cheque or bank payment conditions met
wage_payment_conditions_met.description: Customer input, one per establishment. Omnibus Rules Book III Rule VIII s.2: payment of wages by cheque, money order, bank transfer or e-wallet is customary since the Code took effect or stipulated in a CBA, or all hold — an encashment facility within one kilometre of the workplace, no pecuniary benefit to the employer, reasonable paid time to withdraw, and the employees’ written consent.

bir_qualified_retirement_plan.title: BIR-qualified retirement plan
bir_qualified_retirement_plan.description: Customer input: the employer maintains a reasonable private benefit plan the BIR has approved as tax-qualified (NIRC s.32(B)(6)(a), RA 4917).

processes_sensitive_pi_1000.title: Processes sensitive personal information of 1,000 or more individuals
processes_sensitive_pi_1000.description: Customer input (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.5): mandatory NPC registration below 250 employees.

npc_registered_on.title: NPC registration date
npc_registered_on.description: Customer input: the issue date of the current NPC Certificate of Registration (NPC Circular 2022-04 s.18: valid one year, renewed in the thirty days before it expires).
